site.name: Alice Placer Mine
overview: Alice Placer Mine is a documented historic mining site in Lake County's Leadville mining landscape. A USGS MRDS-derived record places the named site at approximately 39.2500, -106.2772 and classifies it as a past-producing underground zinc property.
moreHistory: The reviewed evidence supports the Alice Placer Mine name, Lake County identity, zinc commodity, patented-holding status, underground operation classification, past-producer status, and a mapped site-level point.

A focused source review did not establish a reliable operator chronology, production record, workings description, or present condition. The mapped point identifies the documented mine site; it should not be treated as a surveyed surviving opening or as proof of an extensive placer-workings landscape.
